title: Hazy Aerial View of Lower Manhattan Skyline, c. 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
location: New York City, New York, United States
description: A high-altitude aerial view looking down at the iconic skyline of Lower Manhattan and surrounding waterways shrouded in light atmospheric haze or clouds. Taken from an aircraft, the photograph captures the dense cluster of early-to-mid 20th-century skyscrapers surrounded by the Hudson and East Rivers. The print features classic mid-century deckled (scalloped) edges.
